# package alarm

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/alarm"
```

Package alarm implements the acyclic real-time transport of PROFINET alarms (RTA, IEC 61158-6-10): the codec of RTA PDUs and the alarm protocol machines of one AR — a sender (APMS) and a receiver (APMR) per priority, with sequence numbers, acknowledgement, retransmission and the ERR PDU that aborts an AR.

RTA PDUs travel on EtherType 0x8892 with FrameID 0xFC01 (high priority) or 0xFE01 (low priority), tagged with 802.1Q priority 6 or 5.

AddFlags bits.

```go
const (
	InitialSendSeq uint16 = 0xFFFF
	InitialAckSeq  uint16 = 0xFFFE
)
```

Initial sequence numbers. The first DATA PDU of an endpoint carries 0xFFFF, the following ones 0, 1, 2, ... wrapping at 0x7FFF (p-net, pnio-rs and profinet-py all number them so); "nothing sent" and "nothing received yet" are 0xFFFE.

```go
const HeaderLen = 12
```

HeaderLen is the length of the RTA header after the FrameID, the VarPartLen included.

```go
const Version = 1
```

Version is the RTA version in the high nibble of the PDU type octet.

#### func (Endpoint) Send

```go
func (e *Endpoint) Send(ctx context.Context, varPart []byte) error
```

Send transmits a DATA PDU carrying varPart and waits for its transport acknowledgement, retransmitting it every Timeout up to Retries times. It returns an error matching profinet.ErrTimeout when the peer never acknowledged (the owner then aborts the AR), and one matching profinet.ErrInvalidConfig, before any sequence number is used, for a varPart longer than 65535 octets.

#### func (Endpoint) SendErr

```go
func (e *Endpoint) SendErr(ctx context.Context, status pnio.Status) error
```

SendErr sends an ERR PDU with status, the abort of the AR.

### type EndpointConfig

```go
type EndpointConfig struct {
	// High selects the high priority (FrameID 0xFC01).
	High bool
	// LocalRef is this side's alarm reference, RemoteRef the peer's.
	LocalRef, RemoteRef uint16
	// RemoteMAC is the peer's address.
	RemoteMAC ethernet.MAC
	// Timeout is the retransmission timeout (RTATimeoutFactor × 100 ms);
	// Retries the number of retransmissions (RTARetries).
	Timeout time.Duration
	Retries int
	// OnData receives the VarPart of every DATA PDU accepted in sequence,
	// on the endpoint's own goroutine (it may call Send). The slice is a
	// copy.
	OnData func(varPart []byte)
	// OnErr is called when the peer sends an ERR PDU (an abort).
	OnErr func(status pnio.Status)
}
```

EndpointConfig configures one priority of the alarm transport of an AR.

```go
}
```

#### func (PDU) AppendEthernet

```go
func (p *PDU) AppendEthernet(dst []byte, to, from ethernet.MAC) []byte
```

AppendEthernet appends the complete tagged Ethernet frame of the PDU.

#### func (PDU) AppendPayload

```go
func (p *PDU) AppendPayload(dst []byte) []byte
```

AppendPayload appends the PROFINET payload of the PDU. A VarPart longer than its 16-bit VarPartLen (65535 octets) cannot be encoded: it panics with an error matching profinet.ErrInvalidConfig rather than encode a wrapped length; [Endpoint](#type-endpoint) refuses such a payload with an error.


TACK reports whether the sender asks for a transport acknowledgement.
